list.empty: Nothing indexed yet. Results appear here as soon as an agent runs a job search.

retention.tooltip: How long indexed jobs are kept before being pruned automatically.
retention.title: Change indexed jobs retention
retention.messageUnlimited: No indexed jobs will be deleted. History will be kept indefinitely.
retention.messageDays: Indexed jobs last seen more than {{count}} days ago will be deleted now.
retention.updatedDeleted_one: Retention updated. {{count}} indexed job older than the window was deleted.
retention.updatedDeleted_other: Retention updated. {{count}} indexed jobs older than the window were deleted.

boards.atsTooltip: Applicant Tracking System: the hiring software a company runs its own job board on (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday).
boards.intro: are searched company by company: none of these providers has a search across all companies, so a job search only reaches the companies listed here. Add the ones you want watched, including the smaller companies that run a board and never post to LinkedIn or Indeed.
boards.queryLabel: Company name, website, or board URL
boards.queryHint: Applyer checks Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby and keeps the board with the most open roles. Workday boards must be added by URL.
boards.empty: No company boards tracked yet. Searches on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workday will return nothing until you add one.
boards.addedEmpty: Tracking {{company}}. Its board is live but has no open roles right now.
boards.addedUnverified: Tracking {{company}}, but its board couldn't be reached to confirm just now. The next search will retry it.
boards.ambiguous: This company also has a live board on {{others}}. Kept the {{provider}} one, which lists the most open roles. The other is usually left behind after moving providers.
boards.colBoardTip: The board id Applyer fetches: the company slug on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby, or the tenant and career site on Workday.
boards.colStatusTip: What the last search got back from this board, or the error if it could not be reached.
boards.loadFailed: Could not read the tracked boards.
boards.refreshFailed: Could not refresh this list, so it may be out of date.
boards.pauseTooltip: Keep the board on the list but stop fetching it during searches.
boards.resumeTooltip: Start fetching this board during searches again.
boards.fetchTooltip: Fetch this board now and update its last result, without running a job search.
boards.fetchedEmpty: {{company}}'s board is live but has no open roles right now.
boards.fetchNotFound: {{company}}'s board did not answer (404). The slug may have changed, or the company may have moved to another ATS.
boards.fetchedMany_one: Checked {{count}} board: {{roles}} open roles in total.
boards.fetchedMany_other: Checked {{count}} boards: {{roles}} open roles in total.
boards.fetchedAllFailed_other: None of the {{count}} selected boards could be fetched.
boards.removeMessage: {{company}}'s postings will no longer appear in job searches. Jobs already queued from it are unaffected.

csv.title: Import boards from CSV
csv.openTooltip: Bulk-add tracked boards from a list of ATS board tokens, such as a published open-data feed.
csv.intro: Add many boards at once from a list of ATS board tokens. Any layout works: match your file's columns to the fields below.
csv.dialogTitle: Choose a CSV of ATS boards
csv.truncated: Only the first {{count}} rows of this file were read.
csv.fieldTokenTip: The company's slug on the provider: the last part of https://jobs.lever.co/acme.
csv.minOpenHint: Open roles. A slug left behind after a company moved provider still answers, with an empty board.
csv.minOpenDisabled: Map an open-roles column to filter by size.
csv.previewNote: Boards with the most open roles are taken first, since a watchlist holds {{limit}} at most.
csv.unchecked: Imported boards are not fetched now. The first search after this checks each one and fills in its last result.
csv.importedNone: No new boards: every row was already tracked, unusable, or over the limit.
csv.planFailed: Could not read that file with those columns.

selection.hint: Click a row to select it, Ctrl or Cmd click to add one, Shift click to select a range.
selection.removeMessage_one: Its postings will no longer appear in job searches. Jobs already queued from it are unaffected.
selection.removeMessage_other: Postings from these {{count}} boards will no longer appear in job searches. Jobs already queued from them are unaffected.

exclusions.intro: URLs on this list are never returned by a job search and can't be queued, whether you or the agent tries to. Exclude a job from its detail view on the board, or add one directly here.
exclusions.removeMessage: This job posting will be searchable and queueable again.
exclusions.removed: Removed from the exclusion list. It can be found by search and queued again.
